definition: a tall pink water bird with a bent beak
description: Inside a wooden birdwatching hide, four people crowd at the open window looking out over a shallow lake. An older man with a white moustache bends to a spotting scope on a tripod, a young woman with green hair holds binoculars, a man beside her stares out, and someone writes in a notebook on the ledge. Outside, hundreds of tall pink birds with long legs stand in the water, and the whole flock lifts off and flies low across the lake with their pink and black wings spread.

de.answer: Sie fliegen über dem See auf.
de.question: Was machen die Flamingos?

es.answer: Están alzando el vuelo sobre el lago.
es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo los flamencos?

fr.answer: Ils prennent leur envol au-dessus du lac.
